payloads.failedObligation: Participant filing-and-timing guidance completeness (filing instructions, fee/waiver, service/notice, destination, deadline/timing, self-help stop).
payloads.allowedWriter: P1 Utah petition completeness repair owner or a newly assigned repair lane that did not perform IV-B verification
payloads.smallestExactRepair: Extend the shared participantInstructions output with source-supported, route-specific BCI and court filing sequence, filing destinations, fee and waiver procedure, service/notice steps, timing/deadline guidance, and an explicit self-help stop. Regenerate each importing family; do not alter legal rules without a separately authorized legal decision.
payloads.rerenderScope: canonical and boundary PDFs plus page rasters and a new exact raster receipt for every affected importer whose packet deliverable embeds or packages the repaired guidance
payloads.requiredIndependentReverifier: A verifier other than IV-B and other than the repair writer, bound to the new exact hashes and raster receipt.
